title: Kalma camp sit-in opposing UNAMID withdrawal, reported in December
location: Kalma camp near Nyala, South Darfur
summary: Dabanga reported the Kalma sit-in had entered its second week by Dec 14. A separate Jan 2 report mentions a week-long sit-in at Kalma, but does not establish that it is the same physical action or that the Dec14 sit-in remained active through Jan1.
notes: Do not merge the Dec14 campaign and the Jan2 week-long sit-in based on location/demand similarity. The Jan2 story's use of 'week-long' does not establish its precise start or end.
open_questions: Is the Jan2 Kalma sit-in the same physical episode as the Dec14 sit-in?
Did either action remain physically active on Jan1?
What was the exact start and physical end?

title: Late-December demonstrations at/around Zalingei UNAMID site
summary: Dabanga's Jan2 report places demonstrations at the Zalingei UNAMID site at the start of that week and a banner photo is captioned Dec31; its retrospective also describes Dec28–31 protests. These are late-December actions, and no specific physical gathering is confirmed as continuing into January.
notes: Do not assign a January onset or merge separate camp solidarity actions. Publication/update dates are not event dates.
open_questions: Did protesters remain gathered at any Zalingei site on Jan1 or later?
What was the specific onset and end of each late-December action?

title: Possible separate Kalma week-long sit-in mentioned Jan2
summary: The Jan2 Dabanga article says Kalma displaced people held a week-long sit-in and delivered a memo, but does not supply exact dates or state whether it physically continued on Jan1/Jan2.
notes: Possible late-December onset is based only on a week-long duration reported Jan2. Keep separate from the Dec14 sit-in lead and do not claim a Jan event or cross-month overlap.
